name: Bad Medicine
summary: At the Rebel Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale, Sergeant Yohwa seeks a way to weaken Colonel Kurzen's force. His medicine men heal his soldiers and poison Yohwa's fighters, and the resistance needs their remedies and toxins.

sections.title: Stripping the Compound's Support
sections.body: Colonel Kurzen's medicine men heal his soldiers and poison Yohwa's fighters with venom fern extract. Sergeant Yohwa asks you to gather their supplies from the Kurzen Compound. The remedies can treat wounded fighters at the Rebel Camp. A sample of venom fern extract will let the resistance study the toxin and make cures of its own.

faq.answer: At the Rebel Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale, Sergeant Yohwa asks you to recover the medical supplies.

faq.q: Why does Sergeant Yohwa want Jungle Remedies?
faq.answer: Kurzen's medicine men use Jungle Remedies to heal their soldiers. The resistance needs the remedies to treat its wounded fighters.

faq.q: What is the Venom Fern Extract used for?
faq.answer: Kurzen's forces use venom fern extract to poison Yohwa's fighters. Yohwa needs a sample so the camp can study the toxin and make remedies against it.

faq.q: Where are these medical supplies kept?
faq.answer: The supplies are inside the Kurzen Compound. Medicine men carry the remedies, while supply boxes around the encampment hold the venom fern extracts.

angles.text: For the Alliance, cutting off Kurzen's healing support can help keep more Rebel Camp fighters alive against his force.
